judgments.reason: The span 'a non-homogeneous, mass-like prominence at the base of the tongue' appears literally in the CT findings and directly supports ectopic thyroid tissue located at the base of the tongue.

The span 'several adjacent 1 cm nodular structures enhanced similarly to thyroid tissue' appears literally in the CT description and supports the presence of ectopic thyroid tissue at that location by identifying tissue with thyroid-like enhancement characteristics.

The span 'no thyroid gland was seen in the usual neck location' appears literally in the CT findings and clinically supports ectopic thyroid tissue at the tongue base by confirming absence of orthotopic thyroid, consistent with lingual ectopic thyroid.
